headline: North Korean group used fake job interviews to infect 30,000 devices
summary: Three reports describe a joint law enforcement advisory on WaterPlum, a North Korean group that used fake job postings and bogus coding tests to install malware on applicants' machines, compromising at least 30,000 devices and stealing more than $10.7 million in cryptocurrency. One adds that more than 7,000 crypto wallets were raided; another gives a December 2025 to July 2026 window. The accounts do not conflict.
